title: a guard file without jitso's marker is refused without --force, and --force backs it up before replacing or removing it
source: intended: setup hook for every harness (claude, codex, opencode, pi): one plan, one preview, one confirmation and one backup
intent: INTENDED behavior, the rule install skill uses for a hand edit. A `.opencode/plugins/jitso-guard.js` or `.pi/extensions/jitso-guard.js` whose first line is not jitso's generated marker is not jitso's: setup hook prints the preview of what --force would do (a diff, as install skill shows a hand edit) and exits 2 with `JITSO REJECTED: <file> was not written by jitso setup hook (no generated marker); nothing written; run again with --force to replace it (a backup is kept)` (`remove it` for --remove), the file untouched. With --force the file is backed up, then replaced (or removed, with the folders it leaves empty).

stderr.equals: JITSO REJECTED: .opencode/plugins/jitso-guard.js was not written by jitso setup hook (no generated marker); nothing written; run again with --force to replace it (a backup is kept)

regex: ^// generated by jitso \S+: jitso setup hook; do not edit

stderr.equals: JITSO REJECTED: .pi/extensions/jitso-guard.js was not written by jitso setup hook (no generated marker); nothing written; run again with --force to remove it (a backup is kept)
